_note: Full 60-card Verdant Circle set, designed to mirror ashborn_cards_batch1.json's schema/conventions exactly. Identity: patient growth and nature magic, rewarding long-game control over early aggression (per FACTION_CLASH_GAME_OVERVIEW.md section 3). Cost curve deliberately shifted right of Ashborn's (fewer 1-3 cost, more 4-6 cost) so games built around this faction naturally lean midgame. Introduces a new keyword, Growth (added to keywords.json in this same delivery, precedent: Echo was added alongside its first card the same way) -- triggers at the start of your turn AND applies to friendly units adjacent to this one, representing a grove spreading its vitality to its neighbors. Spell/support kit is deliberately healing- and buff-weighted rather than damage-weighted (3 damage-dealing spells out of 12, vs Ashborn's 5 of 12) per explicit user direction. UnitType usage follows the user's mapping: humanoid Circle-folk (elves, druids, rangers) = Human, beastfolk/wildlife = Animal, wisps/ents/treants/fairy-spirits = Elemental -- Construct and Dragon are not used anywhere in this set, deliberately, since neither fits Verdant's organic theme. || 100-card expansion (2026-08-17): VER061-100 added to bring Verdant from 60 to 100 cards, per user directive targeting Attack28/Defense28/Support-unit14/Spells20/Support-duration10, matching Ashborn's expansion exactly. 40-card expansion for Verdant Circle (VER061-100), bringing the faction from 60 to 100 cards, mirroring the Ashborn expansion (ashborn_additions.json). Built from the same gap analysis: Verdant's original 60 was Attack15/Defense15/Support-unit10/Spells12/Support-duration8, thin at the very top end (cost 7-9 had zero Support-unit and Support-duration cards, cost 0/7/10 had no Defense units). This batch adds +13 Attack/+13 Defense/+4 Support-unit/+8 Spells/+2 Support-duration, reaching the target Attack28/Defense28/Support-unit14/Spells20/Support-duration10 exactly. Cost curve additions {0:2,1:2,2:2,3:2,4:3,5:4,6:5,7:6,8:6,9:5,10:3} round out every bracket, concentrated most heavily at cost 6-9 where the original set was thinnest. Support-unit and Support-duration additions are concentrated at cost 7-10 specifically to close the 'no support at the top end' gap, the same fix applied to Ashborn. Rarity additions {Common:25,Rare:9,Epic:4,Legendary:2} match Ashborn's additions exactly, reaching Common62/Rare23/Epic10/Legendary5 -- full parity between the two 100-card factions. UnitType additions {Elemental:10,Animal:10,Human:10} keep Verdant's three-type split roughly balanced at the larger scale. Growth keyword used on 8 of the 40 new cards, including two 'spreads to adjacent units' cards (VER079, VER098) that lean into Growth's signature adjacency effect more explicitly than most of the original 60 did. No Construct or Dragon unitTypes used, consistent with the original Verdant 60 (those remain Ashborn-flavored types).
